title.rendered: Youth & Adult Re-Engagement Program Street2succes program

content.rendered:
In February 2026, the Republic of Suriname issued a Social Bond to finance eligible social expenditures and priority social projects.

The Ministry of Finance and Planning (Employer), for the benefit of the Ministry of Youth Development & Sports, intends to engage a qualified consulting firm to implement the Youth & Adult Re-Engagement Program – Dropout Support for Jobs, Skills and Entrepreneurship (Street2Success – From Survival to Success).

The program seeks to address the challenges faced by vulnerable and at-risk youth aged 16–30, including unemployment, school dropout, social exclusion, limited access to vocational opportunities, psychosocial challenges, and reduced participation in economic and community life.

Street2Success combines psychosocial support, mentoring, vocational skills development, entrepreneurship support, job readiness training, and employment pathways into one integrated youth empowerment program.

The program is expected to directly support approximately 1,000 youth across multiple districts of Suriname through a hub-based implementation model.

Scope of Services

Consultant shall provide professional services including:

  • Recruitment, registration, intake, and selection of vulnerable and at-risk youth participants.
  • Delivery of youth empowerment sessions focusing on self-confidence, mental resilience, communication skills, life skills, leadership, recreation, and positive identity formation.
  • Provision of individual and group coaching, mentoring, and psychosocial support referrals.
  • Organization of employment readiness programs, including CV writing, interview preparation, career orientation, and labor market integration.
  • Organization of job fairs, employer engagement activities, internship matching, and apprenticeship opportunities.
  • Delivery of entrepreneurship guidance, business coaching, and financial literacy training.
  • Delivery of Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH) sessions.
  • Management of participant welfare and logistics, including participant registration, meals, refreshments, transportation support where applicable, and training facilities.
  • Development and implementation of a Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) framework.
  • Conduct of baseline, midline, endline, and aftercare assessments.
  • Preparation and submission of quarterly progress reports, evaluation reports, and final project reports.
  • Provision of participant follow-up and aftercare support after project completion.
  • Delivery of district-specific vocational skills training (lot 1-5) through specialized Technical Mentors.

Vocational Training Lots

Lot 1 – Para: Welding / Operator Training / Construction and Infrastructure Skills

Lot 2 – Marowijne: Welding / Operator Training / ICT & Administration

Lot 3 – Coronie: Beekeeping & Honey Production / Sustainable Agriculture / Beauty & Wellness Product Development

Lot 4 – Saramacca: Agricultural Processing / Fruit & Vegetable Processing / Oilfield Operator & Maintenance Training

Lot 5 – Paramaribo & Wanica: Web Design & Development / Digital Media & ICT / Hospitality and Food Services

Duration

The assignment covers 18 months (November 2026 – January 2028), structured into phases with aftercare support extending beyond project completion.

Consultant Qualifications

Interested consulting firms must demonstrate:

  • At least five (5) years of professional experience in youth development, social inclusion programs, community development, workforce development, or related fields.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing youth empowerment programs.
  • Demonstrated experience working with vulnerable youth, NEET youth, school dropouts, and socially excluded populations.
  • Experience delivering psychosocial support programs, mentoring, coaching, and peer-to-peer interventions.
  • Experience implementing vocational training, employability, entrepreneurship, and workforce development initiatives.
  • Proven experience coordinating multi-district and multi-stakeholder programs.
  • Experience collaborating with government institutions, NGOs, educational institutions, community organizations, and private sector partners.
  • Experience organizing job fairs, employment matching programs, internships, apprenticeships, and workforce integration initiatives.
  • Experience in monitoring, evaluation, and reporting of social development programs.
  • Strong administrative, operational, financial, and reporting capacity.
  • Familiarity with the Surinamese socio-economic environment and youth development landscape.
  • Experience with donor-funded programs and international development organizations is considered an advantage.

The Consultant shall demonstrate the availability of qualified key personnel, including:

  • Project Coordinator / Manager
  • Technical Mentors (per vocational Lot)
  • Monitoring & Evaluation Specialist
  • Trainers – Personal Development, Life Skills & Entrepreneurship
  • Trainers – Ready 4 Work / Employment Readiness
  • Trainers – Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH)
  • The Consultant must demonstrate the capacity to provide services in Dutch and English and ensure that reporting requirements can be fulfilled in English. Knowledge of Sranan Tongo is considered an advantage.

Selection Method

Consultants will be selected using the Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) method, in accordance with international procurement policies and practices.

Submission Requirements

  • Interested firms must submit:
  • Letter of Interest (LOI).
  • Proof of legal status (Chamber of Commerce registration).
  • Company profile and evidence of similar assignments in the past 10 years.
  • Description of organizational capacity and areas of specialization.
  • Evidence of relevant experience in Suriname or comparable environments.

All documentation must be submitted in English.

Deadline and Contact

Ministry of Finance and Planning

Background

In February 2026, the Republic of Suriname has issued a Social Bond to finance eligible social expenditures and priority social projects.

The Ministry of Finance and Planning (Employer), for the benefit of the Ministry of Youth Development & Sports, intends to engage a qualified consultancy firm to implement the RISE Program (Direction, Innovation, Skills, Entrepreneurship). The program empowers young entrepreneurs (18–35 years) through structured Business Development Services (BDS), sector-specific vocational training, mentoring, capital allocation, and aftercare.

The program targets:

  • Aspiring Entrepreneurs (Group 1, 350 participants): Build a solid business foundation and receive start-up capital to formally launch their business.
  • Existing Entrepreneurs (Group 2, 350 participants): Strengthen and expand their businesses and apply for financing of equipment or goods.

Scope of Services

The Consultant will provide professional services including:

  • Recruitment and transparent selection of participants across five districts (Paramaribo, Wanica, Nickerie, Commewijne, Brokopondo).
  • Delivery of general BDS training curricula (foundation for Group 1, advanced for Group 2).
  • Implementation of sector-specific training modules (Lots 1–7) in eco-tourism, oil & gas services, recycling & circular economy, ICT & digital services, creative industry, healthcare & natural products, and hospitality & food.
  • Capital allocation and financing support for approved business plans and expansion applications.
  • Individual mentoring, coaching, and aftercare support.
  • Welfare and logistics management (training facilities, meals, participant support).
  • Monitoring, evaluation, and reporting (baseline, mid-term, final, and aftercare assessments).

The assignment covers 18 months, structured into phases: program design, training delivery, capital allocation, and aftercare monitoring.

Consultant Qualifications

Interested firms must demonstrate:

  • At least five (5) years of professional experience in entrepreneurship development and SME support.
  • Proven expertise in Business Development Services (BDS), training, and mentoring of young entrepreneurs.
  • Capacity to deliver sector-specific modules linked to international frameworks (UNWTO, ISO, UNEP, Google, AWS, UNESCO, WHO).
  • Experience in managing funds and capital allocation procedures.
  • Adequate technical and administrative capacity, including qualified personnel (Project Coordinator, BDS Trainers, Sector Specialists, Mentors, Financing Officer, M&E Specialist).
  • Experience in similar assignments in Suriname, the Caribbean, or South America.
  • Familiarity with donor-funded projects (ILO, IDB, EU, UNDP) is an advantage.
  • Mandatory proficiency in Dutch and English (written and spoken).
  • Knowledge of Sranan Tongo for effective communication.
  • Familiarity with Suriname’s economic context and growth sectors.

Selection Method

Consultants will be selected using the Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) method, in accordance with international procurement policies and practices.

Evaluation will consider technical capacity, relevant experience, and cost, in line with international donor procurement practices

Submission Requirements

Interested firms must submit:

  • Letter of Interest (LOI).
  • Proof of legal status (Chamber of Commerce registration).
  • Company profile and evidence of similar assignments in the past 10 years.

title.rendered: IT Equipment for Installation & Upgrade of data storage facilities for e-Government

content.rendered:
This international bidding notice was announced under the General Procurement notice advertised
for this project published in Development Business Online, edition No. IDB-P2134880-08/24 dated
August 27, 2024.

The Government of Suriname has received financing from the Inter-American Development Bank
(IDB), and it intends to apply part of the proceeds to payments under the project Support for the
Population Census and the National Statistical System of Suriname (SPCNSSS), for “IT
Equipment for Installation & Upgrade of data storage facilities for e-Government”.

The Program Executing Unit (PEU) SPCNSSS of the Ministry of Finance and Planning now invites
sealed bids from eligible bidders for the delivery of Equipment for Installation & Upgrade of data
storage facilities for e-Government: Purchase of 2 Firewall (lot 1), 4 Core Switch (lot 2), 5
Datacenter Switch (lot 3), 4 Switch Controllers (lot 4), 4 Top of Rack Switch (lot 5) and Server with
accessories (lot 6). The delivery shall be no later than 16 weeks after contract signature. The
requirements and qualifications are included in the bidding documents.

Bidding will be conducted through International Competitive Bidding procedures as specified in the
Inter-American Development Bank’s Policies for Procurement of Works and Goods financed by
the Inter-American Development Bank (GN-2349-15), and is open to all eligible bidders as defined
in the policies.

Interested eligible bidders may obtain further information from the Program Executing Unit (PEU)
SPCNSSS at the email address stated at the end of the document, during office hours.

The qualification requirements include: – certified providers/partners, National of an IDB member
country, demonstrated experience in supply and installation of enterprise-level data storage
infrastructure, manufacturer authorization, financial capacity, and successful completion of
minimum 2 similar contracts; at least 1 contract ≥ 70% of estimated lot value during the past
five (5) years.

A complete set of bidding documents in English may be requested at the email address below by
interested bidders on the submission of a written application to the email address below. The

Background 

In February 2026, the Republic of Suriname has issued a Social Bond to finance eligible social expenditures and priority social projects.  

As part of the National Housing Program, the Government is implementing the Reeberg Housing Development Project in phases. Blocks 1, 2, and 3A are under execution. The next phase, Block 3B, requires civil infrastructure works to prepare the area for residential housing development. 

The Ministry of Finance and Planning (Employer), for the benefit of the Ministry of Public Works and Spatial Planning, intends to engage a qualified consultancy firm to provide construction supervision and contract administration services for Block 3B. 

Scope of Services 

The Consultant will provide professional services including: 

  • Continuous site supervision of civil works (roads, drainage, culverts, site preparation); 
  • Contract administration, including variations, claims, and payment certification; 
  • Quality assurance and compliance monitoring against approved designs and specifications; 
  • Coordination with the Employer, Contractor, utility agencies, and stakeholders; 
  • Preparation of inception, monthly progress, close-out, and defects notification reports; 
  • Monitoring of occupational health, safety, environmental, and social compliance. 

The implementation period is six (6) months construction supervision, followed by a six (6) months Defects Notification Period (DNP). 

Consultant Qualifications 

Interested firms must demonstrate: 

  • Proof of their legal status as a firm. 
  • At least five (5) years of professional experience in civil infrastructure supervision. 
  • Proven experience in roads, drainage, culverts, and housing development projects. 
  • Adequate technical and administrative capacity, including qualified personnel. 
  • Experience in similar assignments in Suriname, the Caribbean, or South America. 

Selection Method 

Consultants will be selected using the Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) method. 

Submission Requirements 

Interested firms must submit: 

  • Letter of Interest (LOI). 
  • Proof of legal status (Chamber of Commerce registration). 
  • Company profile and evidence of similar assignments in the past 10 years. 
  • Description of organizational capacity and areas of specialization. 
  • Evidence of relevant experience in Suriname or comparable environments. 

All documentation must be submitted in English. 

Deadline and Contact 

Expressions of Interest must be delivered by 19 June 2026 via email to: 

Ministry of Finance and Planning   

Attn: Procurement Lead – Priority Social Projects Paramaribo, Suriname  

Email: [email]
